# Vocabulary agentic-workflows/v0

Agentic workflows, such as GitHub Agentic Workflows: what starts each one, what its agent can reach and write, its budgets and imports, and groups of workflows that work together. Defined in docs/models/agentic-workflow-model.md. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/agentic-workflows/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/agentic-workflows/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/agentic-workflows/v0.json).

An extraction follows this vocabulary when its `vocabularies` include it; its `schema` must be `architecture/v0`. The extraction schema applies this one to it.
